_comment: How an all-caps event title is changed to title case (ConvertTo-TvTitleCase in ingestion/scripts/lib/Schema.ps1). A word in keepUpper stays capitalized, and so does a word with no vowels (DJ, CSL, BBQ) or a Roman numeral. forms gives a word's exact spelling. smallWords are lowercase except at the start or after a colon. Words are matched in uppercase.
